head: codex/59-codex-goal-replacement-readiness
title: [v0.92][Codex goals] Route blocked-goal replacement to platform authority
body:
Part of agent-logic/agent-design-language#59

## Summary
- records the source-grounded boundary between ADL policy and the externally owned Codex goal service
- preserves the existing blocked goal, status, time, and token accounting as historical truth
- defines the bounded upstream replacement or supersession contract and fail-closed active-goal overwrite behavior
- publishes only a non-closing authority-routing checkpoint; no ADL goal implementation or policy workaround is introduced

## Validation
- `git diff --check`: PASS
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate6`: PASS, 10 tests
- typed C-SDLC v2 validation and doctor: PASS

## Review
- independent exact-head review approved `ea07513854599c602ca2208ba031f804fe922c86` with no P0-P3 findings
- review confirmed the qualified `part_of` relationship, external authority boundary, and absence of any ADL implementation claim

## Remaining external work
The Codex platform owner must implement the product change and pass the live blocked-goal replacement canary before issue 59 can reach terminal completion.
